clips.en: Excuse me, is the restroom up ahead?
notes: 洗手间: 洗 xǐ and 手 shǒu are both third tone, so 洗 rises: xí shǒujiān.
吗 at the end is light and short.

clips.en: I take the subway to the airport.
notes: 地铁 dìtiě: a falling tone, then a third tone that dips.
机场 jīchǎng: the ch is the curled-tongue sound.

clips.en: The school is close to my home.
notes: 学校 xuéxiào: a rise, then a fall.
近 jìn (close) and 进 jìn (enter) sound the same; the sentence tells you which one it is.

clips.en: He runs every morning.
notes: 每天 měitiān: 每 is a third tone before a first tone, so it only dips.
都 dōu is high and flat, and sits before the verb: 都跑步.

clips.en: I like playing soccer most.
notes: 踢足球: 踢 tī is high and flat, 足 zú and 球 qiú both rise.
喜欢 xǐhuan: 欢 is light.

clips.zh: 他比我高，但是我跑得很快。
clips.en: He is taller than me, but I run fast.
notes: 比我 bǐ wǒ: two third tones in a row, so 比 rises: bí wǒ.
跑得很快 pǎo de hěn kuài: 得 is just a light de.

clips.zh: 因为下雨，所以我们在家看电影。
clips.en: Because it is raining, we watch a movie at home.
notes: 所以 suǒyǐ: two third tones, so 所 rises: suóyǐ.
因为 and 所以 come as a pair: when you hear one, listen for the other.

clips.en: Do you want black tea or green tea?
notes: 你想 nǐ xiǎng: two third tones, so 你 rises: ní xiǎng.
红茶 hóngchá is "red tea" in Chinese; English calls it black tea.

clips.en: I have been to China twice.
notes: 去过 qùguo: 过 is light when it shows an experience.
两次 liǎng cì: with a measure word, "two" is 两 liǎng, not 二 èr.

clips.en: Please tell me your name.
notes: 请你 qǐng nǐ: two third tones, so 请 rises: qíng nǐ.
告诉 gàosu: 诉 is light.

clips.en: She teaches us Chinese.
notes: 教 jiāo (to teach) is high and flat; 叫 jiào (to be called) falls. They are easy to mix up.
们 in 我们 is light.

clips.en: The door is open; please come in.
notes: 开着 kāizhe: 着 is light here.
进来 jìnlái: 进 falls, 来 rises.

clips.en: I have already finished eating.
notes: 已经 yǐjīng: 已 is a third tone before a first tone, so it only dips.
了 at the end is light; it shows the eating is finished.

clips.en: Do not go; sit a little longer.
notes: 别 bié (do not) rises; 比 bǐ (than) dips.
一会儿 yíhuìr: 一 changes to yí before the fourth tone 会.

clips.en: The teacher asks us not to talk.
notes: 老师 lǎoshī: 老 is a third tone before a first tone, so it only dips.
别说话 bié shuōhuà: rising, high, then falling.

clips.en: This movie is very interesting.
notes: 很有 hěn yǒu: two third tones, so 很 rises: hén yǒu.
意思 yìsi: 思 is light.

clips.en: My phone is on the table.
notes: 手机 shǒujī: 手 is a third tone before a first tone, so it only dips.
桌子 zhuōzi: 子 is light.

clips.zh: 我不想出国，我想在家休息。
clips.en: I do not want to go abroad; I want to rest at home.
notes: 不想 bù xiǎng: 不 stays fourth tone before a third tone; it changes only before another fourth tone.
出国 chūguó: high and flat, then rising.

clips.zh: 他个子很高，打篮球打得很好。
clips.en: He is tall and plays basketball very well.
notes: 个子 gèzi: 子 is light.
打篮球 dǎ lánqiú: 打 dips, 篮 and 球 both rise.

clips.zh: 从我家到车站走路要十分钟。
clips.en: It takes ten minutes to walk from my home to the station.
notes: 车站 chēzhàn: both the ch and the zh are curled-tongue sounds.
从…到… means from … to …: you hear 从 first and 到 later.

clips.zh: 他经常和朋友一起去游泳。
clips.en: He often goes swimming with friends.
notes: 一起 yìqǐ: 一 is yì before the third tone 起.
朋友 péngyou: 友 is light.

clips.zh: 今天是晴天，我们出去玩吧。
clips.en: Today is sunny; let us go out and play.
notes: 晴天 qíngtiān: a rise, then high and flat.
吧 at the end is light and invites agreement.

clips.zh: 虽然很累，但是我很高兴。
clips.en: Although I am tired, I am happy.
notes: 虽然 suīrán: 虽 is high and flat, 然 rises.
但是 dànshì: both syllables fall.

clips.zh: 他可能不在家，你给他打电话吧。
clips.en: He may not be at home; you should call him.
notes: 可能 kěnéng: 可 is a third tone before a rising tone, so it only dips.
打电话 dǎ diànhuà: 打 dips, then two falling tones.
